title: High Protein Slovakian Turkey Nimono
description: A fermented, crisp, and light Slovakian dish featuring turkey, nimono-simmer, high in protein, this recipe is perfect for a healthy dinner option.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together caraway seeds, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the turkey strips to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey strips to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, chicken broth, and apple cider vinegar to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the skillet with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Before serving, remove the skillet from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Serve the turkey and sauerkraut mixture hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
